text: Yes, there was deforestation on this asset in 2023. The tool detected a 4.5-hectare loss of tree cover that year, representing about 0.12% of the asset. The event was corroborated by two independent datasets: the Hansen Global Forest Change and the JRC Global Forest Cover 2020, which confirmed that the area was forested in 2020. The lost area was primarily planted forest (4.3 hectares) with pine species (*Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*), not native forest. The event met the minimum size threshold of 0.5 hectares.
